answer: Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent burns only once. Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. The identity then has to pass a fable challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next garden. Registration needs a proof of work of 21 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the sparrow. That is 11 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
